description: Proposed development associated with change of use of first,  second and third floors from Class E to two residential units (Class C3) involving first-floor rear extension and internal alterations.

font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small; margin: 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: black;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish, and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-373c7fb8-7fff-5ed8-a22b-6301c64f7963"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building. </span></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in full (requiring the change of use of the&nbsp;first,&nbsp;second, and third floors of 43 Charlotte Road from Class E to two residential units) and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and thereafter retained like so unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved, to protect the Priority Office Area.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">No permission is granted for the removal of any historic floorboards, and these shall be retained in situ. However, should floorboards need to be lifted/removed for essential repair works, a method statement is to be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp; Any new floorboards shall exactly match the historic floorboards in terms of size and material. Any new flooring above the historic floorboards shall be of a ‘floating floor’ construction method that does not damage the historic floorboards.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-335d690f-7fff-2e5b-69af-5422b48d54dd"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building.</span></p>

<p>Prior to occupation, a Waste Management Plan detailing arrangements of&nbsp;<span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;">council-contracted&nbsp;street-side</span>&nbsp;refuse collections as well as internal refuse bins integrated into the kitchens of the 2 x flats must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing. The development shall be implemented as per the approved details and retained like so.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development is in accordance with Hackney's refuse and waste policies.</p>

<div style="">Prior to occupation details in the form of cross section drawings at a scale of 1:20 of the planters on the terrace must be provided showing a minimum depth of 0.5m as well as a planting plan incorporating a diverse mix of species, including native species beneficial to local wildlife; and a management and maintenance plan must be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority.&nbsp; The development shall be implemented as per the approved details.&nbsp;<br></div><div style=""></div><div style="">REASON: To enhance the character and ecology of the development, to provide undisturbed refuges for wildlife, and to promote sustainable urban drainage.</div>

<p>Prior to occupation of the development, details of obscured glazed screens at a height of 1.7m to the terrace shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be implemented as per the approved details.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p><p>REASON: To protect the privacy of neighbouring properties in Curtain and Charlotte Roads.&nbsp;</p><p><i style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><b><br></b></i></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">No additional punctuations in the external walls and roofs shall be permitted other than as shown on the drawings hereby approved.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5c7e2e89-7fff-a120-f050-7057aea7cf06"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building.</span></p>
